meta.source: Hoolala_Mono_LCD_Design_System_v1 (tokens.json, tokens.css, DESIGN_SYSTEM.md), converted to list format

tokens.name: lcd-bg
tokens.usage: The LCD screen. Default background of every app surface.

tokens.name: lcd-surface
tokens.usage: Paper. Message blocks, inputs, secondary keys, raised inserts. Also reversed-out text on lcd-ink (12.4:1).

tokens.name: lcd-sunken
tokens.usage: Depth. Sunken panels, pressed states, quiet wells. lcd-ink on it is 8.5:1.

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: All important text, 2px rules and borders, icons, the selected bar and primary keys. 9.9:1 on lcd-bg.

tokens.name: lcd-ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, dashed dividers, placeholder text. 6.6:1 on lcd-bg, 5.7:1 on lcd-sunken.

tokens.name: lcd-outline
tokens.usage: Dotted and dashed outlines, decorative frames.

tokens.name: lcd-selected
tokens.usage: Focused or selected row and primary key fill.

tokens.name: lcd-selected-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lcd-selected.

tokens.name: shell-bg
tokens.usage: Device shell in marketing and demo mockups only. Never inside the product UI.

tokens.name: shell-elevated
tokens.usage: Shell buttons and bezel highlights in mockups only.

tokens.name: surround-bg
tokens.usage: Page around the LCD on desktop and in docs. lcd-ink on it is 12.9:1.

tokens.name: surround-accent
tokens.usage: One display phrase on surround-bg (e.g. the second line of the tagline), 4.8:1. Never body text, never on lcd-bg.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title. Use clamp(22px, 5vw, 28px) in code. Max two short lines.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Keys, menu options, softkeys. Never below 14px for a control.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Kickers, status bar, supplementary labels only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I'll be in town on Saturday. Fancy a coffee?
styles.usage: Notes, replies, prompts, inputs. Sentence case, never forced uppercase.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline emphasis, sender names in body.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Honesty notes and helper text, lcd-ink-secondary.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Half step, dense icon detail.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The base unit. Gaps between keys.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Key and row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen gutter, block padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separations, desktop gutters.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Every key, input, block and row. Squared, pixel feel.

tokens.name: radius-shell
tokens.usage: Device shell in mockups only.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every control.

tokens.name: menu-row
tokens.usage: Minimum menu option height.

tokens.name: border-pixel
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Pixel icons drawn on a 16 x 16 grid, shown at 24 or 32px with image-rendering: pixelated.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum text measure on desktop.

tokens.name: screen-min
tokens.usage: Smallest supported viewport.

tokens.name: motion-step
tokens.usage: Stepped inversion flash on press. Off with reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-message
tokens.usage: Maximum for a message or screen entrance.
